title: codehelion partitioned scan report v1
description: Machine-readable result of a scan that keeps source findings separated by build variant.

cross_variant_comparison.description: Optional exact Type-1 comparison between distinct build variants. It never merges the partition findings.

cross_variant_comparison_status.description: Why an explicitly requested exact Type-1 build-variant comparison did not run. This is distinct from a completed comparison with zero groups.

cross_language_comparison.description: Optional restricted semantic comparison between language-specific partitions. It never merges the partition findings.
